classifier.rule: build failure is classified on the SET of distinct, order-independent diagnostic codes (severity | -W flag | normalised message), not on any single message
classifier.determinism: the set is collected with SIL_DIAG_COLLECT=1 via tools/sil_cc.py, which returns 0 on a failed compile so Ceedling compiles every remaining translation unit instead of aborting at the first. The set is therefore a union over all units and does not depend on Ceedling's unstable per-test file order.
classifier.replaced: the previous classifier keyed on `first_error`, i.e. on whichever message arrived first, and flipped between build:other and build:ceedling_cmock_config_quirk for test_os_freertos.c (22/24 vs 2/24 over 24 clean runs)
